text:
amy: Quick sync — running a half-day workshop tomorrow to finalize the webinar narrative + benchmark claims. Need alignment on the messaging ladder vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors. :calendar:
jordan: Good call. agenda?
amy: 1) benchmark topline numbers to promote, 2) messaging frames vs clouds / LLM APIs / infra vendors, 3) inbound routing + lead QA, 4) webinar CTAs + follow-up playbook.
sam_p: I'll bring the latest perf matrix and notes on model fallbacks. TL;DR: 40-60% cost delta on 8k tokens with caching enabled vs default cloud endpoints on our test workload.
tess_research: adding nuance — for short-chat workloads the delta shrinks, so we should avoid blanket % claims in the post.
lee_sales: Sales wants 3 one-liners we can use in outreach. Can we distill to: cost, latency, predictable capacity?
amy: Yes. Proposed quick lines: "Predictable throughput, fraction of token cost at scale, production SLAs." Thoughts?
jordan: Strong. Also add "same API across hosted/dedicated/private" — that's a core differentiator vs infra vendors.
sam_p: Agreed. Also recommend we call out smart routing + KV cache as the features that drive the economics.
bench-bot: automated report uploaded: https://files.redwood/bench/1987654321/report.csv
nora_ops: For inbound routing — propose we tag webinar registrants with lead_source=webinar-bench and route tiered leads to SDR queue A, enterprise interest to AE queue.
lee_sales: Works. Need a simple decision table for ops to implement.
amy: I'll draft the routing table during the workshop. Example rule sketch: ```if demo_request==true or company_size>=500: route->AE_queue else if usage_intent==poc: route->SDR_queue```
tess_research: Also add a metric check node: if claim == "40%" then check sample set (n>200) and confidence interval. We should avoid being disproven in field.
jordan: For the webinar slide deck, keep 2 benchmark slides: one high-level claim, one transparency slide with methodology + anonymized config.
sam_p: I can produce the methodology blurb: model family, sequence length distribution, batching config, quantization profile.
lee_sales: Can we get a short battlecard (1-pager) comparing messaging vs: Cloud AI (simplicity, but opaque pricing), LLM API providers (broad model access, lower control), Infra vendors (control but heavy ops). We need rebuttals.
amy: Yes — owner: lee_sales will draft bullets, sam_p + tess_research to validate any numbers. Jordan to review tone.
lee_sales: Draft will include: Pain -> Our claim -> Proof point -> Play for salesperson.
nora_ops: On routing technicals — I'll add an example webhook payload for CRM: ```{ "lead_source":"webinar-bench", "interest":"dedicated", "score":72 }```
jordan: CTA after webinar: 1) self-serve trial w/ credit, 2) book a capacity consult (AE), 3) run a custom benchmark (SE). We should wire landing pages accordingly.
amy: Agree. Who owns the launch post? marketing will, but need a technical review. Sam_p can sign off on numbers.
sam_p: I'll review. Can we lock language: "up to 60% lower token cost in sustained workloads with prefix caching" — tentative until we finalize sampling.
tess_research: Replace "up to" with "observed reductions up to" to be safer.
lee_sales: Perfect. For webinar Q&A, prepare short scripts addressing: "How is this different from managed endpoints?" and "What happens to model updates?"
jordan: I'll own the Q&A doc and provide canned responses.
amy: OK — workshop tomorrow 10:00-13:00 in the main room. Bring one slide per owner, and one short demo clip (30s).
lee_sales: Adding: can we run a mini playtest with 5 AEs after the workshop? quick feedback loop.
amy: Yes — schedule it.
nora_ops: I'll add the routing spec to the ops backlog and open a PR after workshop.
nora_ops: PR title: "webinar-1987654321-lead-routing-spec"
bench-bot: reminder: weekly bench update scheduled Friday 09:00.
amy: Thanks all. If anyone has blockers share now. Otherwise see you tomorrow. :rocket:
